description:
List a Batch run's result rows, a page at a time: up to limit rows (default 100, max 1000) and next_cursor. Pass next_cursor back as cursor to continue; it is null once every row was read.

Each row has task_id, external_id, url, metadata, status (successful, failed, pending, processing, expired), type, result_url when successful, and error when failed. A result_url is presigned and expires after 2 hours: call batch_results again for a fresh one, or read the body with batch_content. Results are kept 14 days by default; after that a successful row reads as status "expired", with no result_url, and batch_content answers BATCH_RESULT_EXPIRED.

Filter with status: all (default), successful, failed, or processing (not finished yet). A sparse filter can return fewer rows than limit with next_cursor still set: keep paging. While the run is still running or writing its tasks, the list is partial.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous batch_results call

job_id.description: Batch job id returned by batch_create or batch_list

run_id.description: An earlier run's id (from batch_status or batch_rerun). Default: the job's latest run.

status.description: Filter rows by status (default all). processing = tasks not finished yet. successful also returns expired rows.

name: batch_results
